_doc: Slide-2 exec-summary / thesis. DISTILLED from the partner proposal; proposal is source of truth.
positioning: India's ride-hail leader, on the water
thesis: Six high-value India markets — all six on the map with sealed corridors and economics pending on new eastern/southeastern routes.
the_deal: An Uber-branded foiling water tier across Mumbai, Goa, Kerala backwaters, the Andaman islands, Kolkata's Hooghly waterfront and Chennai's ECR coast — booked in-app on sealed Atlas corridors.

your_world.label: Where you are today
your_world.text: Uber is India's premium ride-hail leader — the default app in metros and tourism corridors.

your_world.label: What you're up against
your_world.text: Road congestion and premium island/resort transfers are structural; no ride-hail platform owns the water.

your_world.label: Where Navier fits
your_world.text: A foiling water tier in the Uber app across all six India consumer markets…

your_world.label: Why now
your_world.text: Foiling lifts the hull clear of the water: faster, ~10x more efficient per passenger-mile…
